DMED 500.title: Foundations of Digital Entertainment
DMED 500.description: Business, technological, social, and ethical issues of digital entertainment introduced and framed though historical exploration and critical analysis of economics, technical innovations, social demands, and ethical constraints involved.

DMED 501.title: Visual Story
DMED 501.description: The many facets of storytelling are explored, with an emphasis on development of narrative using shape, colour, line, texture, and composition, as well as text and sound.

DMED 502.title: Improvising Story and Character
DMED 502.description: Techniques of improvisational acting are used to develop collaborative and creative skills in building dramatic themes, narratives, and characters.

DMED 503.title: Foundations of Game Design
DMED 503.description: Analysis of games as rules, games as play, and games as culture. Students make both physical and electronic games as part of this course.

DMED 510.title: Financing and Distribution of Digital Entertainment
DMED 510.description: Methods of financing and distributing video games, mobile content, theatrical feature films, television projects, and series. Drafting and negotiating contracts and intellectual property law related to digital entertainment.

DMED 520.title: Projects I: Building Virtual Worlds
DMED 520.description: Student teams design and implement an artifact in a virtual environment. Management and business aspects of team-based creation are studied.

DMED 530.title: Internship
DMED 530.description: Full-time work experience related to digital media or entertainment technology, outside the university. Students learn effective communication, collaboration, project management, and team cooperation. Pass/Fail.
